'''Shafu''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who made a career as a [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] tracked down Shafu and convinced him to change his ways, leading the Rodian to become Zallow's undercover agent in the criminal underworld. Near the end of the Great Galactic War, Shafu's investigations into a network of Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spies]] led to his [[Death/Legends|death]] when his [[Shafu's ship|sabotaged starship]] exploded over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|<nowiki>Jedi = correct // Master Zallow = sent Shafu on secret mission // Shafu = gave his life for Republic</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="Shafu's Report" />}}
A [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Shafu worked as a [[Slavery/Legends|enslaver]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], transporting slaves in his [[Shafu's ship|starship]].<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" /> The [[T7-series astromech droid|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]] served as Shafu's navigator but never entered the cargo hold where the slaves were kept, and so was unaware of Shafu's actual trade.<ref name="The Confession">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Confession}}</ref> Sometime before [[3681 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ven Zallow]] tracked down Shafu. However, instead of arresting the Rodian, Zallow convinced Shafu to give up his career as a enslaver and return to [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], where Shafu freed hundreds of slaves.<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" /> Giving T7-O1 to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master,<ref name="The Confession" /> Shafu went on to work as an undercover [[operative]] for Zallow, infiltrating the criminal underworld during the Great Galactic War.<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" />

During the war, Zallow sent Shafu to investigate rumors of an Imperial [[Spy/Legends|spy]] in the upper echelons of the Republic.<ref name="Shafu's Report" /> Shafu intercepted a message from the [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Eckhorn Baliss]] that contained a list of Imperial sympathizers in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and revealed Baliss to be an Imperial spy. However, Baliss was [[Death/Legends|killed]]<ref name="Eckhorn's List">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|Eckhorn's List}}</ref> in [[3663 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> and Shafu continued his investigations over the next [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]], determining that Baliss had attempted to blackmail an Imperial plant in the Senate and was killed for it. Shafu compiled a report on his investigations and submitted it shortly before Zallow's death in [[3653 BBY]], but Zallow died before seeing the message, and it was deleted from official communications. Shafu was killed himself not long afterward by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Terrin Sandafar]], who [[Saboteur/Legends|sabotaged]] Shafu's ship so that it exploded over the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].<ref name="Shafu's Report" />

Years later, T7-O1 learned of Shafu's death&mdash;which had been ruled accidental&mdash;and rebuilt Shafu's report from the deleted files.<ref name="Shafu's Report" /> Using Shafu's report, T7-O1 identified the spy and Sandafar's employer as the [[Verre Sydia's husband|husband]] of [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Verre Sydia]], and the man was arrested.<ref name="The Senator's Secret">{{TORcite|type=conversation|T7-O1|The Senator's Secret}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|<nowiki>Master Zallow = convinced Shafu to reform // Shafu = gave T7 to Master Zallow</nowiki>|T7-O1|<ref name="The Confession" />}}
The Rodian Shafu was a enslaver before the Great Galactic War, but Ven Zallow was able to convince him to abandon his career and free his captives. Shafu became loyal to Zallow, risking his life as Zallow's undercover operative in the criminal underworld. T7-O1 believed that Shafu underestimated the [[Astromech droid/Legends|droid]] and his capabilities.<ref name="Slaver's Redemption" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shafu was mentioned in a conversation with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class companion character T7-O1 in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] on [[December 20]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shafu's Report" />
